correctness.rationale: For all n>=5 the trig fourth moment is exact; the resulting 3-row Parseval Gram is a rank-three projection. Perron–Frobenius and ring cyclic symmetry reduce the absolute Gram spectral radius to the explicit 2x2 matrix. Cusp-free finite cosine sum provides closed expression. Piecewise Fourier integration with explicit jumps of 4pi sqrt15 at both zeros gives uniform O(n^-3); Taylor and density of irrational rotations give exact limsup/liminf. Bundled checker passed and is not used as proof of infinite quantifiers.
